profiles.name: Mira
profiles.persona: Has run the bread stall by the fountain for eleven years and knows every regular by name. Proud of her stall and quick to notice when something is missing.
profiles.speaking_style: Warm and quick, a little breathless when she is upset.

profiles.name: Bran
profiles.persona: Walks the same circuit of the market every day and would rather talk a problem down than draw a weapon.
profiles.speaking_style: Measured and formal, fond of stating procedure.

profiles.name: Corin
profiles.persona: Light fingered and always three stalls ahead of whoever is looking for him. Not cruel, just hungry and fast.
profiles.speaking_style: Clipped and evasive, answers a question with a question.
